summary: Product manager for grid-scale BESS with a utility and construction background, eight years at LG Energy Solution moving from systems engineering to product ownership. Originated the 2-hour containerized product that became LG's flagship for AI data center power, with multi-GWh bookings. Works across power systems engineering, techno-economic modeling, and Python tooling to turn site-level constraints into deployable hardware and pricing.

bullets.label: Roadmap Ownership & Commercial Impact
bullets.text: Expanded the product portfolio from 4-hour to 2-hour duration with an AC-integrated containerized BESS to capture emerging AI data center demand; secured executive and commercial buy-in to establish the platform as LG's flagship offering for the segment, driving multi-GWh forward bookings for 2027 delivery.

bullets.label: Techno-Economics & Pricing Strategy
bullets.text: Built bottom-up cell-to-system cost, EPC installation, and logistics models to set competitive system pricing, evaluate PCS configurations, and quantify the margin, energy density, and transport advantages of the 2-hour architecture.

bullets.label: Technical Translation & System Requirements
bullets.text: Translated hyperscale and AI data center power constraints into core BESS requirements: authored specifications for compute step-load transient smoothing, voltage fault ride-through with active recovery, gas turbine pairing, black start and islanding, and capacity management for non-firm interconnection with curtailment.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Led PCS vendor selection and owned the UL 9540 listing path; served as the product interface between engineering, sales, and project execution, aligning volume commitments, cost-down trajectory, development and certification schedules, technical documentation, and commissioning and service procedures.

experience.title: Senior Systems Engineer, Grid-Scale BESS (LG Chem)
bullets: Led product engineering for LG's first prefabricated containerized BESS (2.86 MWh/unit); partnered with contract manufacturer Jabil from architecture through functional prototype, managing cost, safety, and size/weight tradeoffs to replace bespoke field assembly and deliver nearly 1 GWh across CAISO and ERCOT.

Developed Python and spreadsheet degradation models simulating calendar and cycle aging, C-rate, temperature, and depth of discharge; optimized battery-to-inverter ratios and augmentation schedules to minimize lifetime cost while satisfying developer warranty terms.

Directed technical sales engineering for integrators, EPCs, and IPP/developers; led requirements capture, system sizing, and RFP/RFI technical defense, translating site duty-cycle constraints into pre-construction proposals.

experience.title: Design-Build Engineering Manager, HVAC
bullets: Managed end-to-end commercial HVAC delivery on active construction sites: scope definition, equipment selection, and mechanical and electrical commissioning and startup, coordinating with general contractors, architects, and developers.
Owned estimating, procurement, and field operations; produced mechanical bids, directed trade installer crews, and negotiated in-flight change orders to protect margin and schedule.

experience.title: Energy Solutions Engineer
bullets: Delivered 2.5 MW of peak demand reduction and 7 GWh of cumulative energy savings across commercial and industrial portfolios through customer-facing technical audits, incentive structuring, and capital project evaluation.

Engineered efficiency and demand-response projects for data centers and critical facilities: developed technical scopes and savings models for data center cooling retrofits (hot/cold aisle containment, economizers, VFDs), central plant systems (chillers, boilers, AHUs), and behind-the-meter thermal and battery peak-shifting assets.

bullets.text: Engineered an automated pipeline ingesting 100+ equity and macroeconomic research PDFs daily (16,000+ total); parsed unstructured multi-asset commentary into structured JSON schemas with verbatim anchor quotes, programmatically verifying every extracted metric against source text before database commit.

bullets.label: Morning Pulse Synthesis
bullets.text: Built the automated "Morning Pulse" briefing, published every trading day (110+ issues) with a lead theme, desk-call trade board, and economic and earnings calendar drawn from live options chains and agency APIs; a redesigned synthesis pipeline in shadow pilot raised extraction fidelity against source PDFs from 33–60% to 87–100% and cut grouping fragmentation from 30–60% to 9–16%.

bullets.label: Cited RAG Agent
bullets.text: Built an interactive Q&A agent executing cited answers over the research corpus (1,470+ production queries); regex-based tool router restricts model actions per query, and a payload provenance guard blocks any figure absent from tool output.
